todos.title: Get UK passports for the children
todos.notes: Children are British citizens by descent (Nick is British by birth). First-time passport application from Germany.

subtasks.title: Gather required documents: children's German birth certificates (Geburtsurkunden)
Get certified English translations of birth certificates (official translator)
Locate Nick's UK birth certificate or current UK passport as proof of citizenship
Get passport photos for each child (UK spec: 45mm x 35mm, plain light background)
Find countersignatory (British citizen, professional, known you 2+ years, not family)
Complete online application at gov.uk/overseas-passports for each child
Pay fees: £57.50 per child (standard) or £135.50 (fast-track)
Upload/send documents and photos to UK Passport Office
Wait for processing (3 weeks standard, 1 week fast-track) and delivery

todos.title: Start German citizenship application
todos.notes: Nick has 10 years residency (exceeds 5-year minimum), B1 certificate, and naturalization test completed. Ready to apply. Timeline: 18-24 months processing.

subtasks.title: Identify local Einbürgerungsbehörde (naturalization office) and check appointment system
Gather core documents: valid passport, German residence permit, birth certificate with translation
Gather financial documents: payslips (last 6 months), employment contract, rental contract
Gather proof of health insurance (Krankenversicherung)
Locate B1 German language certificate (already completed)
Locate naturalization test certificate (already completed)
Prepare CV in German (Lebenslauf) with residency timeline
Complete application form (Antrag auf Einbürgerung) — download from Behörde or fill at appointment
Book appointment at Einbürgerungsbehörde to submit application
Submit application with all documents at appointment
Pay application fee: €255 (at appointment or after approval)
Wait for processing (18-24 months) — may receive requests for additional documents
Upon approval, pay certificate fee: €25
Receive Einbürgerungsurkunde (naturalization certificate)
